subject: SOC2 Type II + targeted control extracts — MFA transaction slice & privileged session captures
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia.park@acmecorp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Health Compliance Team <audits@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and narrow control artifacts (MFA, sessions)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. As part of Acme Health's annual vendor audit we need the SOC 2 Type II report for the period Apr 1, 2025 — Mar 31, 2026 and a brief bridge letter that confirms continuity for any gaps between the report and our audit window.

Beyond the report itself, our auditors require a small set of narrow extracts to validate controls:
- MFA transaction events for all "privileged" accounts (admin, infra, billing) covering 2025-10-01 through 2026-03-31 (we expect a sample, not full log stream)
- Privileged session snapshots (screen metadata / session start/end, IP, role asserted) for five representative admin sessions
- Access review artifacts for the most recent recertification cycle (who approved, timestamp, scope of the review)
- SAML assertion traces for the SSO integration used by Acme (including assertion timestamps and subject identifiers)

Please confirm whether you can provide pseudonymized identifiers (hashed UPNs) for MFA and SAML traces — our auditors will accept pseudonymization if we receive a mapping statement and a manifest file describing the hash method.

Attached is our scope matrix (acme_audit_scope_matrix.xlsx) showing the specific control IDs auditors flagged.

Can you confirm feasible delivery dates and any constraints (export windows, redaction policies)? Also let us know if we should expect a bridge-letter draft first or the final signed letter.

Appreciate a short reply with ETA.

Thanks,
Julia Park
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager
Acme Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and narrow control artifacts (MFA, sessions)

Hi Julia — thanks for the clear matrix and the ask. We can support the request but will need to scope a few items before committing to delivery dates. High-level plan:

1) SOC 2 Type II (final report) and bridge letter
   - We can provide the Type II report for Apr 1, 2025 — Mar 31, 2026.
   - Draft bridge letter available within 3 business days; signed version follows procurement signature (we can indicate a target sign date).

2) Targeted control artifacts
   - MFA transaction slice: we propose delivering a pseudonymized CSV sample (manifest included) covering the requested window. We normally sample by transaction (every Nth event) and include a checksum manifest and hashing description.
   - Privileged session snapshots: these are produced as metadata extracts (no screen recordings). We can produce five representative snapshots but will need approval on scope of what counts as "privileged" (attached checklist).
   - Access review records & SAML traces: we can export approvals and SAML assertion logs as described.

3) Redaction & pseudonymization
   - We can pseudonymize identifiers using salted SHA-256 and provide the manifest describing salt handling (salt kept internal). If Acme requires reversible mapping, please advise and we can escalate to legal.

Attachments: evidence_request_checklist.xlsx, bridge-template-draft.docx (draft language for your auditors).

Next steps: can you confirm acceptance of pseudonymized identifiers and whether the auditors require reversible mappings or live identifiers? With that confirmed I will coordinate exports with Kimberly (logs) and Laura (access review artifacts) and share a delivery timeline.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and narrow control artifacts (MFA, sessions)

Karthik / Laura — quick ops note on exports:

- MFA transactions: we can run a targeted export by event type (MFA success/fail, method) for the requested interval. Estimated run time: 2 business days to extract & validate sample slices; another day to generate manifest and pseudonymize.
- SAML traces: these are in our centralized auth logs; we can pull assertion level events including timestamps, assertion ID, subject identifier (pseudonymized).
- Privileged session metadata: we do not capture pixel-level screen recordings; we provide session start/stop, role asserted, originating IP, and audit action list.
- Access reviews: Laura — can you confirm we have the signed recertification report for Q4 2025? I will attach the export as PDF once confirmed.

Constraints: exports require temporary elevated access for the compliance engineer; procurement will sign the export authorization. We estimate a full deliverable (draft bridge + artifacts) by Mon, May 24 if approvals come through this week.

-Kimberly
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and narrow control artifacts (MFA, sessions)

Hi Julia — quick update and confirmation:

- SOC 2 Type II report (Apr 1, 2025 — Mar 31, 2026): attached via secure link (see Drive link).
- Draft bridge letter: we prepared a draft and shared it on the Drive link; we can route for signature after you confirm acceptance language.
- MFA transaction slice: we will provide a pseudonymized CSV (SHA-256 salted) covering 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31 with a manifest describing sampling method (randomized reservoir sample capped at 10k events).
- Privileged session snapshots: five metadata snapshots will be included (start/end, role, IP, actions).
- Access review artifacts: Laura has confirmed the signed recertification PDF and we will include it.
- SAML assertion traces: included in the export (pseudonymized subject IDs).

Delivery ETA: 1 business day to grant access to the Drive package and 3 business days for the export files after export authorization (HS-12487). If auditors need reversible identifiers, let us know immediately — reversible mappings require a legal review and longer lead time.

Link: https://redwood.example.com/drive/Acme/Bridge_Letter_Draft
HubSpot ticket: HS-12487

If that timeline works I'll proceed with Proc/Legal authorization for the exports.

Best,
Karthik

Redwood Inference
